content: आरोपः .²1 Attributing the nature or properties of one thing to another; वस्तुन्यवस्त्वारोपोऽध्यारोपः <ls>Vedānta S.</ls>; attributing or assigning to, imputation; दोषारोपो गुणेष्वपि <ls>Ak.</ls> .²2 Considering as equal; identification (as in सारोपा लक्षणा). .²3 Super-imposition. .²4 Imposing (as a burden), burdening or charging with. .²5 Placing in or upon. .²6 Relating to. .²7 Superior position.
